---
title: "SQ03 Storage and Expansion Upgrades"
description: "Research, install, and verify a compatible SATA, NVMe, or PCIe device."
pathway: "Side Quest"
categories: [side quest, storage, SATA, NVMe, PCIe, upgrade, 120 minutes, data risk, optional lab]
---

**Pathway:** {{< meta pathway >}}\
**Prerequisites:** CS03, CS05, CS06\
**Previous:** [SQ02 Fault stations](sq02-fault-stations.qmd)\
**Next:** [SQ04 Linux inventory](sq04-linux-inventory.qmd)

State the upgrade purpose and success measure. Research physical form factor, interface/keying, port or lane availability, power, firmware support, operating-system support, and the data plan.

After approval, protect required data, install the device without forcing it, inspect before power, verify it in firmware and Linux, and run an appropriate test.

For a device visible in firmware but absent in Linux, inspect inventory, driver support, partition/filesystem state, mount state, and logs. Do not initialize, format, or overwrite a drive without explicit approval.

Submit the compatibility table, installation record, verification, and updated asset record.
